AUTHOR: Soom
TITLE: Open real-time, non-invasive fish detection and size estimation utilizing binocular camera system in a Portuguese river affected by hydropeaking
REGION: Avelames River (Bragado) and Couto River (Covas do Barroso), Tamega/Douro basin, Portugal
SPECIES: Footage contains Northern Iberian chub, Northern straight-mouth nase, brown trout; detector outputs fish, classified juvenile/adult by 10 cm size threshold
DATA: PTFish dataset (own; 18,523 annotated IR+RGB stereo frames from flow-refuge cameras, EcoPeak4Fish project)
V_EV: Table 5 frame counts by time of day incl. 'Night, 21:00-06:00' with IR camera; Table 7 'ArUco marker distances from the camera (cm)' 25.2-46.2 cm.
D2: 80/20 hold-out (14,818 train/test with repeated random sub-sampling; 3705 validation frames)
D_EV: Sec. 2.3.1: 'The dataset was split into separate datasets for training and validation using a ratio of 80:20'; Fig. 1: 'frames are selected at specific intervals to avoid having similar samples.'
R_EV: Sec. 3.1: evaluation 'performed using a hold-out validation dataset composed of 3705 frames' drawn from the same PTFish collection (both sites included in the dataset).
E_EV: Sec. 2.5: 'Fish measuring less than 10 cm in length were categorized as juveniles. ... the number of juvenile and adult fish was counted and averaged per second of the video.'
ARCH: YOLOv8s (selected over YOLOv8n, YOLOv10n/s, RT-DETR-l, DEYO-N) + IR/RGB stereo disparity depth and bounding-box size estimation on Jetson Orin Nano
METR: Precision, recall, F1, mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95; depth/size absolute and relative error (ArUco markers); FPS, power
NOTE: Size/depth estimation validated only with ArUco markers of known size in the field, not with independently measured fish -> E5=없음. E1 '복수': fish length/size classes, per-second counts and refuge use over hydropeaking cycles, no comparison with any reference. Paper calls the procedure k-fold, but describes an 80:20 hold-out plus random sub-sampling of frames; coded as random frame split with interval frame selection to avoid similar samples (D3=Y). No detection confidence threshold reported. Detector class count not stated (appears single 'fish' class) -> NCLASS null.
AUTHORS_FULL: Soom, J; Boavida, I; Leite, R; Costa, MJ; Toming, G; Leier, M; Tuhtan, JA
